title: Held-out test of the default papyrus -> air (Z_out) order of checkpoint A on Frag2, Frag5 and Frag6
status_before_labels: Frag2, Frag5 and Frag6 ink labels not downloaded; no score computed on these fragments
label_of_results: exploratory; Frag2 was a Kaggle 2023 training fragment; exclusion of Frag5 and Frag6 from A's lineage is not attested

rule_under_test.origin: phase14-discovery.json on 19 seen ROIs (Frag4, Frag1, Frag3): mean ROC-AUC Z_out 0.675, Z_in 0.562, rank average 0.651, oracle 0.713; no label-free selector (score std, upper tail, spatial coherence, surface correlation) beat the fixed rule

regions.rule: phase11_geometry.select_patches on the published mask (1/8 grid); 1024 x 1024 px at 2.215 um from the 3.24 um surface volume, as phase11_z_frag4.prepare
regions.support: mask eroded by 16 output px and Hann weight >= 25 % of maximum
regions.exclusion: a ROI with fewer than 1000 valid positive or 1000 valid negative label pixels is reported but left out of the pooled tests

direction.rule: label-free, as phase 13: median over the 8 patches (64 x 64 px, inside mask) of the standard deviation of each surface-volume layer; the end (layers 0-12 or 52-64) with the lower mean value is air
direction.use: Z_out = papyrus -> air, Z_in = air -> papyrus, physically; planes mirrored about layer 32 when air is at layers 0-12
direction.surface_layer_check: Frag2: z of surface_volume.ppm at a masked pixel must be 32; Frag5 and Frag6 publish no identity PPM, so only the 65-layer surface volume (centre 32) is checked

intensity: W2 per fragment, phase11_window rule: mean and std of layers 11..53 on 128 x 128 px around the 8 patches, inside mask, matched to 0.379 and 0.148

labels.source: inklabels.png of each surface directory, same grid mapping as the CT input, nearest neighbour

scores.B1: non-learned: 1 - mean of input planes 30 and 31 / 255
scores.B2: non-learned: local standard deviation (Gaussian sigma 4 px) of the mean of input planes 26..35, / 255

metrics.pooling: per fragment, included ROIs concatenated; block bootstrap 64 x 64 px, 499 draws, seed 208, same draws for every score (paired differences)
metrics.per_roi: point estimates of every metric, reported for all ROIs

hypotheses.H3: per fragment: lower 95 % bound of pooled ROC-AUC(Z_out) > 0.5
hypotheses.H4: per fragment: lower 95 % bound of the paired difference PR-AUC(Z_out) - PR-AUC(Z_in) > 0
hypotheses.H5: per fragment: lower 95 % bound of the paired difference ROC-AUC(Z_out) - max(ROC-AUC(B1), ROC-AUC(B2)) > 0, the baseline chosen per bootstrap draw
hypotheses.generalization: Z_out is called a usable default only if H3 holds in all three held-out fragments

not_allowed_after_labels: changing ROIs, direction rule, window, scores, exclusion rule, rule under test or hypotheses
reporting a subset of fragments or ROIs
